defects.detail: קָרְחָה (baldness) rendered 'a cutting of the flesh'
לְהַחְלִיט וּלְהַסְגִּיר (to confirm [as unclean] or to quarantine) rendered 'to declare clean or to shut away'

defects.detail: 'de Roei-schepen leeg van boord waren' (rowing ships were lightened/unladen) rendered 'the rowing ships were empty of board'

'die het op het Vaartuig ontkoomen waren' (who had escaped on the vessel) rendered 'escaped to the vessel'; Christians made co-deciders ('and two or three Christians') rather than the ones to carry out the plan

reason: Faithful account of the demonstration, cannon fire, and the spiking plan; small slips in 'leeg van boord' and the escaped Christians clause

defects.detail: 'virtus visina' (visual power, virtus visiva) rendered 'The vital power'
'caule et foliis obtusis' (crushed stem and leaves) rendered 'stem and leaves, with their obtuse thorns'

'marie qua ei lac mulieris admiscet. serpentum morsibus...' (especially when woman's milk is mixed in. [It] heals snakebites) merged into 'in the manner in which one mixes women's milk with it, it heals the bites of serpents'
'semen eius inextricabilia vicia stomachi curat' rendered 'Its seed taken internally cures stomach ailments'
'secundum gradum' (in the second degree) rendered 'according to the degree'

reason: Lettuce and burdock chapters fully rendered; several term slips (virtus visiva as 'vital power', obtusis as 'thorns', maxime clause merged, inextricabilia as 'taken internally')

defects.detail: phonetic exemplar characters (早古, 早坤, 法男 ...) glossed by lexical meaning ('Early Ancient', 'Early Earth', 'Law Male'), which misrepresents them as words rather than sound-class exemplars

reason: Every table cell and header carried over; exemplar characters given lexical glosses, which is literal but misleading for a rhyme table

defects.detail: meta 'continues from previous page: ...He had a' imports the previous page's 'feit mettre en champ de bataille vn'

reason: Elephant, tiger-bred dogs, flight into the cavern, Scythian soldier's shout all = source; only a page-boundary fragment in the meta tag

defects.detail: v.22 'विपर्यये न सिद्धिः स्याच्छुभाद्यत्रापि' (if reversed there is no success, even when auspicious) rendered 'The result is reversed if the figures are inauspicious'
v.23 list of five questions (मुष्टि, मूक, शरुत्पत्र/varṣapatra, अवधि, प्रश्नहर/thief) given as 'the fist, the silent, and the duration of a question, among others'

v.19 'तिथौ' (15th, as a number word) rendered 'fifteenth house on that date'

reason: Commentary on 17-18 and verses 19-24 present, but v.22 sense changed, v.23 list cut short, number words विश्वशक्र/तिथि misread as epithet and date; weak on the Sanskrit

defects.detail: 'بل ربما المجفف والمانع ... يردع مادة ما ينبت' (the drying agent may repel the matter of growth) rendered 'might, in some respects, stimulate the matter from which it grows'
'ويجب ان يغتذي المريض المراد انبات اللحم ... ' (the patient should be nourished with good food) rendered 'It is necessary for the patient to be moderate ... without excessive, unnecessary growth'
'العوضة' in the opening lines glossed as ‘afwah 'the healing process'
'اذا كانت الجراحة القطع منها لم كثر' (if much was cut away) rendered 'it does not become excessive'
final 'وارضا' expanded to '[this is] the last resort'

reason: Later part on nerve wounds and amputation sound; earlier clauses on flesh-growing agents and nourishing the patient mistranslated or reversed; weak on manuscript Arabic

defects.detail: 'さい四じふきはめたる' rendered as 'He had decided on four parts'; 'るる。つる' as 'Flowing. Stork' — fragmented kuzushiji OCR given definite lexical readings
'小へ。くり。きて' rendered 'To the small room. Entering. Coming' — 'room' has no counterpart

reason: Line-by-line rendering of a heavily garbled kuzushiji OCR; keeps the fragmentation but assigns confident meanings to many unreadable tokens; source too corrupt to judge closely
Ecclesiastes, Job, Ecclesiasticus, Genesis, Alanus and Bernard citations all rendered = source; stops mid-sentence where source does

'دتڠڤي دان دجيمڤي اوله بكنده لاكي استري' (received and embraced by the king and queen) reduced to 'The request was accepted and granted by the King'
